research_basis: Hajer's published UAE green-SME driver research, the Green SME Drivers survey, the finance-driven Fuzzy DEMATEL and TOPSIS paper, and the revised GreenSMECapt framework dated 2026-09-19.

domains.title: Financing environment and investor conditions
domains.description: External funding availability, terms, mandates and investor perceptions around the SME.

domains.title: Institutional, regulatory and ecosystem conditions
domains.description: Rules, compliance, public programmes and ecosystem support that enable or constrain transition.

domains.title: Organisational and capability readiness
domains.description: Internal leadership, people, systems, skills, technology and operational capabilities.

domains.title: Market, procurement and supply-chain conditions
domains.description: Demand, buyer requirements, procurement routes, branding and supply-chain pressure.

factors.title: Green-finance availability
factors.definition: Availability of suitable green-finance products to the SME.

factors.title: Grants and guarantees
factors.definition: Availability of grants, guarantees and related risk-sharing support.

factors.title: Impact and ESG-linked finance
factors.definition: Availability of impact-oriented or ESG-linked financing structures.

factors.title: Financing costs
factors.definition: Cost and affordability of external finance for green transition.

factors.title: Investor risk perception
factors.definition: How investors perceive the risk of the SME and proposed transition.

factors.title: Funder mandates
factors.definition: Eligibility and policy mandates applied by funders.

factors.title: Public-private financing coordination
factors.definition: Coordination between public and private actors in financing provision.

factors.title: Regulation
factors.definition: Regulatory conditions affecting green-SME activity and transition.

factors.title: Legal and environmental compliance
factors.definition: Ability to satisfy relevant legal and environmental requirements.

factors.title: Certification
factors.definition: Availability and attainability of relevant environmental or market certification.

factors.title: Government programmes and incentives
factors.definition: Public programmes and incentives supporting transition.

factors.title: Technology support
factors.definition: External support for identifying, acquiring or implementing technology.

factors.title: Universities and incubators
factors.definition: Research, incubation and capability support from knowledge institutions.

factors.title: Stakeholder and public-private coordination
factors.definition: Coordination among ecosystem stakeholders and public-private actors.

factors.title: Leadership commitment
factors.definition: Leadership commitment to environmental transition and implementation.

factors.title: Employee engagement
factors.definition: Employee participation in environmental change and delivery.

factors.title: Management systems and KPIs
factors.definition: Internal management systems, ownership and performance indicators.

factors.title: Technical competence
factors.definition: Technical knowledge and skills required to execute the transition.

factors.title: Organisational learning
factors.definition: Capacity to learn, adapt and retain transition capabilities.

factors.title: Technology adoption
factors.definition: Ability and willingness to adopt suitable technologies.

factors.title: Operational efficiency
factors.definition: Capability to improve processes and use resources effectively.

factors.title: Digital monitoring and data capability
factors.definition: Capability to collect, monitor and use reliable operational data.

factors.title: Consumer demand
factors.definition: Customer demand for greener products, services or operations.

factors.title: Buyer requirements
factors.definition: Environmental requirements imposed by commercial buyers.

factors.title: Sustainable procurement opportunities
factors.definition: Access to procurement opportunities rewarding environmental performance.

factors.title: Tender exposure
factors.definition: Exposure to tender requirements and qualification processes.

factors.title: Green branding
factors.definition: Market value and credibility associated with green positioning.

factors.title: Supply-chain pressure
factors.definition: Environmental expectations transmitted through supply-chain relationships.
